name: get_kernel_syms
description: Retrieves exported kernel and module symbols. If the table pointer is NULL, it returns the number of symbols available for query. Otherwise, it fills in the provided table with symbol information, including interspersed magic symbols for modules.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of struct kernel_sym structures; if NULL, the function returns the number of symbols available instead of filling the table.

return_value.success: Returns the number of symbols copied to table
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: get_kernel_syms() is not supported in this version of the kernel.

bugs: There is no way to indicate the size of the buffer allocated for table. If symbols have been added to the kernel since the program queried for the symbol table size, memory will be corrupted. The length of exported symbol names is limited to 59 characters. Because of these limitations, this system call is deprecated in favor of query_module(2).
